channel.title: Sam 🌋 Wild Adventures — Guides & Field Notes
channel.description: Practical Japan outdoor guides, cold-weather mountaineering gear roundups, mountain route guides, and expedition field notes.

item.title: Hokkaidō Backcountry Ski Touring: Niseko & Mt. Yotei Guide (2026–2027)
item.description: Complete guide to Hokkaidō backcountry ski touring in Niseko and Mt. Yotei (1,898 m): official Niseko gate rules, guide booking strategies, flying avalanche airbags on JAL and ANA, January vs February timing, and uphill layering.

item.title: High-Altitude Mountaineering Layering System: 4,000m to 6,500m (Tested Guide)
item.description: The ultimate 6-layer high-altitude mountaineering clothing system from 4,000m to 6,500m (Brynje mesh base, R1 Air grid fleece, breathable windshell, synthetic belay jacket, Gore-Tex Pro hardshell, and 800FP expedition down parka) plus the 3-glove rule.

item.title: Skiing Mt. Fuji in Spring: Corn Snow, Routes & Gear (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: Skiing Mt. Fuji in spring: corn snow (zarame) timing, Fujinomiya vs Fuji Subaru Line routes, 30° icy fall lines, crampon transitions, crater rim skiing and off-season permits (tozan todoke).

item.title: How to Keep Phone & Action Camera Batteries Alive in Extreme Cold (2027)
item.description: How to keep phone, action camera and power bank batteries alive in extreme sub-zero cold down to -20°C and -40°C. Explains voltage sag vs drain, lithium plating hazards, silicone cables, low-temp cells and body-heat routing.

item.title: Tokyo: 7 Best Mountaineering, Trail & Backcountry Ski Gear Shops (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: The 7 best mountaineering, backcountry ski and ultralight gear shops in Tokyo (Ishii Sports Kanda, Calafate Mejiro, MoonlightGear, Montbell Kyobashi, Runboys! Rungirls!, Kojitusanso & Kanda Ski Street) with tax-free and sizing advice.

item.title: Matterhorn vs. Mont Blanc: Which to Climb First? (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: Matterhorn vs Mont Blanc difficulty, cost, guide ratio and progression: compare Hörnli Ridge (AD III, 1:1 ratio, CHF 1,550 guide) against Mont Blanc Goûter Route (PD+, 1:2 ratio, €2,580 package), Grand Couloir rockfall and hut rules.

item.title: Tokyo: 6 Best Mountain Day Hikes by Train with Onsen (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: The 6 best car-free mountain day hikes from Tokyo under 2 hours by train (Jinba–Takao, Mitake–Odake, Tonodake Okura Ridge, Mt. Kawanori, Mt. Oyama & Nokogiriyama), paired with trailhead natural onsen, yen fees and closure warnings.

item.title: 7 Best Adventure Wearables, GPS Watches & Cold-Weather Gadgets Above 4,000m (2027)
item.description: Field-focused guide to the 7 best adventure wearables, GPS watches, satellite messengers and sub-zero gadgets for mountaineering and ski touring (Garmin Enduro 3, inReach Mini 2, Oura Ring 4, Osmo Action 5 Pro, Nitecore NB10000, Petzl Swift RL & Plaud NotePin).

item.title: Tokyo: 6 Best 24-Hour Super Sento, Saunas & Cold Plunges (2026–2027 Guide)
item.description: The 6 best 24-hour and late-night super sento, natural onsen, saunas and cold plunges in Tokyo (Spa LaQua, Thermae-Yu, Toyosu Manyo Club, Haneda T3, Heiwajima & Spadium Japon) with yen prices, cleaning hours and tattoo policies.

item.title: Ski Touring Mt. Yotei (Hokkaidō, 1,898m): Guide Strategy, Turnaround & Summit
item.description: Backcountry ski touring Mt. Yotei (1,898m) near Niseko in Hokkaidō: why booking a two-day guided window made the difference between a tree-line turnaround and a crater-rim ski.

item.title: Riding Vietnam by Motorbike (Ho Chi Minh to Hanoi): 40 Days on a Honda Win
item.description: Buying a manual Honda Win copy on Bui Vien in Ho Chi Minh City, learning clutch control the night before departure, and riding 40 days north to Hanoi and back.

item.title: Matterhorn Acclimatisation Week in Valais: Barrhorn, Weissmies & Breithorn Guide
item.description: How to structure a 4,000m Valais acclimatisation and progression week before climbing the Matterhorn: Üssers Barrhorn (3,610m), Weissmies (4,017m) and the Breithorn traverse (4,164m).

item.title: Mongolia Horseback & Motorbike Trip Report: Steppe Ger Homestays to Terelj
item.description: Riding the Mongolian steppe on horseback staying with nomadic herding families, followed by three days to Terelj on rented Soviet-era motorbikes.

item.title: 5 Mountaineering & Ski Touring Gear Mistakes That End Climbs (Field Lessons)
item.description: Five real kit and layering failures watched firsthand on Mt. Yotei, Kilimanjaro, Mont Blanc and the Matterhorn — and the pre-trip checklist that prevents all five for free.

item.title: High-Altitude Climbing Lessons (4,000m to 6,500m): Mont Blanc, Kilimanjaro & Aconcagua
item.description: Practical altitude and acclimatisation lessons from 4,000m to 6,500m across Mont Blanc, Aconcagua, Kilimanjaro and the Matterhorn — including what caused a 6,500m turnaround.

item.title: Climbing the Matterhorn (Hörnli Ridge, 4,478m): Two Attempts & What Changed
item.description: What it actually takes to climb the Matterhorn via the Hörnli Ridge (4,478m): turning back at 3,800m in 2025 vs summiting in 3h20 as first party on the mountain in 2026.

item.title: Climbing Mont Blanc (Goûter Route, 4,808m): First Crampons to Summit in 5 Days
item.description: Climbing Mont Blanc (4,808m) via the Cosmiques Arête build-up and Goûter Route: honest lessons from going from first crampons on the Mer de Glace to summit in five days.

item.title: Climbing Kilimanjaro (5,895m): 7-Day Group Pacing, Acclimatisation & Summit Night
item.description: Seven days climbing Kilimanjaro (5,895m) with a group of eight friends: pacing, hydration, why two climbers turned back, and how previous 6,500m Aconcagua lessons paid off.
